# env-composition

Typed app env from the env blocks bundled features register, plus app-level blocks in extend.

## README

# Env composition

Build the app's env schema from the blocks the mounted features register,
instead of keeping a hand-written copy of every feature's variables.

## What it shows

- **Feature blocks**: `createSecretsFeature`, `createCryptoShreddingFeature`
  and `createFileProviderS3Feature({ fromEnv: true })` register `secretsEnvSchema`,
  `kmsEnvSchema` and `s3EnvSchema`. `composeEnvSchema` collects them and
  records which feature declared each variable.
- **App-level blocks in `extend`**: `buildInfoEnvSchema`, `demoAdminEnvSchema`,
  `stripeEnvSchema({ prices })`, `paddleEnvSchema({ prices })` and
  `createS3EnvSchema({ prefix })` for a
  second bucket. These belong to no mounted feature, so the app adds them.
- **Typed result**: `parseEnv(composed.schema, …)` returns the merged type,
  so `parsed.S3_BUCKET` is `string | undefined` and `parsed.APP_PUBLIC_URL` is
  `string` without a cast.
- **Error report**: a missing required variable is listed with its source
  (`secrets`, `app`, …).

## Blocks

| Block                                          | Where it lives            | Registered by                                         |
| ---------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `kmsEnvSchema`                                 | `crypto-shredding`        | `createCryptoShreddingFeature()`                      |
| `smtpEnvSchema`                                | `channel-email`           | `createChannelEmailFeature()`                         |
| `s3EnvSchema`, `createS3EnvSchema({ prefix })` | `file-provider-s3`        | `createFileProviderS3Feature({ fromEnv: true })`      |
| `stripeEnvSchema({ prices })`                  | `subscription-stripe`     | app (`extend`); the feature registers the bridge keys |
| `paddleEnvSchema({ prices })`                  | `subscription-paddle`     | app (`extend`); the feature registers the bridge keys |
| `mfaTokenSecretsEnvSchema`                     | `auth-mfa`                | `createAuthMfaFeature()`                              |
| `buildInfoEnvSchema`, `demoAdminEnvSchema`     | `foundation-shared`       | app (`extend`)                                        |
| `prometheusMetricsEnvSchema`                   | `framework/observability` | app (`extend`)                                        |

## When to reach for it

Every app that boots with `runProdApp`. Pass the composed schema as
`envSchema` and read the parsed values instead of `process.env`.

## Source files

### bin/server.ts

```ts
// Production entrypoint. The env schema covers the same feature list that
// runProdApp mounts, so `KUMIKO_DRY_RUN_ENV=boot bun bin/server.ts` lists
// every variable of this app without connecting anywhere.
import { runProdApp } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime";
import { composeAppEnv, createEnvCompositionFeatures } from "../src/env";

const features = createEnvCompositionFeatures();

await runProdApp({
  features: [...features],
  envSchema: composeAppEnv(features),
  // The recipe declares no PII fields; crypto-shredding is mounted only for
  // its env block.
  allowPlaintextPii: "env-composition recipe has no PII fields",
});
```

### src/__tests__/dry-run-boot.test.ts

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { composeAppEnv } from "../env";

const serverEntry = join(import.meta.dir, "..", "..", "bin", "server.ts");

const completeValues = {
  DATABASE_URL: "postgres://app@127.0.0.1:1/app",
  REDIS_URL: "redis://127.0.0.1:1",
  JWT_SECRET: "j".repeat(32),
  KUMIKO_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY_V1: Buffer.alloc(32, 7).toString("base64"),
  DEMO_ADMIN_EMAIL: "admin@example.com",
  DEMO_SYSADMIN_EMAIL: "root@example.com",
  APP_PUBLIC_URL: "https://app.example.com",
};

// The child gets only these variables, never the test runner's env, so a
// DATABASE_URL on the CI host cannot leak into the "empty env" case.
async function runBootDryRun(variables: Readonly<Record<string, string>>) {
  const child = Bun.spawn([process.execPath, serverEntry], {
    env: { PATH: process.env["PATH"] ?? "", KUMIKO_DRY_RUN_ENV: "boot", ...variables },
    stdout: "pipe",
    stderr: "pipe",
  });
  const [stdout, stderr, exitCode] = await Promise.all([
    new Response(child.stdout).text(),
    new Response(child.stderr).text(),
    child.exited,
  ]);
  return { stdout, stderr, exitCode };
}

function requiredVariableNames(): readonly string[] {
  const { schema } = composeAppEnv();
  return Object.entries(schema.shape)
    .filter(([, field]) => !field.safeParse(undefined).success)
    .map(([name]) => name);
}

describe("KUMIKO_DRY_RUN_ENV=boot", () => {
  test("exits 0 on an empty env and lists every required variable as missing", async () => {
    const { stdout, exitCode } = await runBootDryRun({});

    expect(exitCode).toBe(0);
    const required = requiredVariableNames();
    expect(required).toContain("DATABASE_URL");
    for (const name of [...required, "JWT_SECRET"]) {
      expect(stdout).toMatch(new RegExp(`^\\s+${name}\\s+\\S+\\s+required\\s+missing$`, "m"));
    }
    expect(stdout).toContain("Feature wiring was NOT validated");
  });

  test("exits 0 on an empty env with NODE_ENV=production", async () => {
    const { exitCode } = await runBootDryRun({ NODE_ENV: "production" });

    expect(exitCode).toBe(0);
  });

  test("validates the wiring once every required variable is set", async () => {
    const { stdout, exitCode } = await runBootDryRun(completeValues);

    expect(exitCode).toBe(0);
    expect(stdout).toContain("All variables present.");
  });

  test("rejects a keyring the master-key provider cannot use", async () => {
    const { exitCode } = await runBootDryRun({
      ...completeValues,
      KUMIKO_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY_CURRENT_VERSION: "2",
    });

    expect(exitCode).toBe(1);
  });

  test("prints no value even when every variable is invalid", async () => {
    const { schema } = composeAppEnv();
    const leaking = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(schema.shape).map((name) => [name, `LEAK_${name}`]),
    );
    const { stdout, stderr, exitCode } = await runBootDryRun(leaking);

    expect(exitCode).toBe(1);
    expect(`${stdout}${stderr}`).not.toContain("LEAK_");
  });

  test("exits 1 on an invalid value and never prints it", async () => {
    const endpoint = "http://s3.leak-check.example.com";
    const { stdout, stderr, exitCode } = await runBootDryRun({
      NODE_ENV: "production",
      S3_ENDPOINT: endpoint,
    });

    expect(exitCode).toBe(1);
    expect(stdout).toMatch(/S3_ENDPOINT\s+file-provider-s3-env\s+optional\s+invalid/);
    expect(`${stdout}${stderr}`).not.toContain("leak-check");
  });
});
```

### src/__tests__/env.test.ts

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { KumikoBootError, parseEnv } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/env";
import { composeAppEnv } from "../env";

const masterKey = randomBytes(32).toString("base64");

const minimalValidValues = {
  DATABASE_URL: "postgres://app@localhost/app",
  REDIS_URL: "redis://localhost:6379",
  KUMIKO_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY_V1: masterKey,
  DEMO_ADMIN_EMAIL: "admin@example.com",
  DEMO_SYSADMIN_EMAIL: "root@example.com",
  APP_PUBLIC_URL: "https://app.example.com",
};

describe("env composition", () => {
  test("collects every block with the feature that declared it", () => {
    const { sources } = composeAppEnv();

    expect(sources["KUMIKO_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY_V1"]).toBe("secrets");
    expect(sources["PLATFORM_KEK"]).toBe("crypto-shredding");
    expect(sources["S3_BUCKET"]).toBe("file-provider-s3-env");
    expect(sources["RELEASES_S3_BUCKET"]).toBe("app");
    expect(sources["STRIPE_PRICE_PRO"]).toBe("app");
    expect(sources["PADDLE_PRICE_PRO"]).toBe("app");
  });

  test("parses into a typed env", () => {
    const composed = composeAppEnv();
    const parsed = parseEnv(composed.schema, {
      ...minimalValidValues,
      S3_BUCKET: "uploads",
      STRIPE_PRICE_PRO: "price_pro",
      PADDLE_PRICE_PRO: "pri_pro",
    });

    const bucket: string | undefined = parsed.S3_BUCKET;
    const publicUrl: string = parsed.APP_PUBLIC_URL;
    expect(bucket).toBe("uploads");
    expect(publicUrl).toBe("https://app.example.com");
    expect(parsed.KUMIKO_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY_CURRENT_VERSION).toBe("1");
    expect(parsed.PADDLE_PRICE_PRO).toBe("pri_pro");
  });

  test("reports every missing required variable with its source", () => {
    const composed = composeAppEnv();
    let report = "";
    try {
      parseEnv(composed.schema, {}, { sources: composed.sources });
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof KumikoBootError)) throw err;
      report = err.format();
    }

    expect(report).toContain("DATABASE_URL (framework-core, required, missing)");
    expect(report).toContain("KUMIKO_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY_V1 (secrets, required, missing)");
    expect(report).toContain("DEMO_ADMIN_EMAIL (app, required, missing)");
    expect(report).toContain("APP_PUBLIC_URL (app, required, missing)");
    expect(report).not.toContain("S3_BUCKET");
  });

  test("rejects a remote http S3 endpoint in production", () => {
    const composed = composeAppEnv();
    const originalNodeEnv = process.env["NODE_ENV"];
    process.env["NODE_ENV"] = "production";
    try {
      expect(() =>
        parseEnv(composed.schema, { ...minimalValidValues, S3_ENDPOINT: "http://s3.example.com" }),
      ).toThrow(KumikoBootError);
    } finally {
      if (originalNodeEnv === undefined) delete process.env["NODE_ENV"];
      else process.env["NODE_ENV"] = originalNodeEnv;
    }
  });
});
```

### src/env.ts

```ts
// Env Composition Sample
// Shows: the app env schema is composed from the blocks the mounted features
// register, plus app-level blocks in `extend`. The parsed env is typed from
// those blocks, so no app keeps a hand-written twin of a feature's variables.

import { createConfigFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/config";
import { createCryptoShreddingFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/crypto-shredding";
import { createFileFoundationFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/file-foundation";
import {
  createFileProviderS3Feature,
  createS3EnvSchema,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/file-provider-s3";
import {
  buildInfoEnvSchema,
  demoAdminEnvSchema,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/foundation-shared";
import { createSecretsFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/secrets";
import { paddleEnvSchema } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/subscription-paddle";
import { stripeEnvSchema } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/subscription-stripe";
import { frameworkCoreEnvSchema } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-dev-server/env-schema";
import { composeEnvSchema } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/env";
import * as z from "zod";

export function createEnvCompositionFeatures() {
  return [
    createConfigFeature(),
    createSecretsFeature(),
    createCryptoShreddingFeature(),
    createFileFoundationFeature(),
    createFileProviderS3Feature({ fromEnv: true }),
  ] as const;
}

// App-level blocks: none of these belong to a mounted feature, so they go
// into extend. A second bucket reuses the S3 block under its own prefix.
const appEnvSchema = z.object({
  ...buildInfoEnvSchema.shape,
  ...demoAdminEnvSchema.shape,
  ...stripeEnvSchema({ prices: ["PRO", "TEAM"] }).shape,
  ...paddleEnvSchema({ prices: ["PRO", "TEAM"] }).shape,
  ...createS3EnvSchema({ prefix: "RELEASES_S3_" }).shape,
  APP_PUBLIC_URL: z.url().describe("Public origin of the app, used in mail links."),
});

export function composeAppEnv(
  features: ReturnType<typeof createEnvCompositionFeatures> = createEnvCompositionFeatures(),
) {
  return composeEnvSchema({ core: frameworkCoreEnvSchema, features, extend: appEnvSchema });
}
```
